column1: A mobile app that connects students who need tutoring with senior students who can teach. Students can book 30-minute sessions and pay using mobile wallets. The app will take 10% commission.
Eco-friendly bags made from old newspapers and magazines. We will collect waste paper from schools, make decorative bags, and sell them at local markets and school events.

A mobile repair shop in our locality with home service. Customers can call us and we will come to their house to repair. We will charge extra for home service but it will save their time and travel cost.
An online platform for local artisans to sell handmade products directly to customers without middlemen.
A bicycle rental service near tourist spots to provide eco-friendly transportation options.
